blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO–Becky Hammon is blunt and brutally honest. Her Las Vegas Aces are on the brink of their offseason arriving earlier than hoped if they can’t get it together in a hurry back home. The defending WNBA champions are down 2-0 to the upstart Golden State Valkyries in the WNBA semifinals. Hammon fully believes Las Vegas can win three straight and return to the finals. The Aces host Game 3 on Friday night. Yet the coach insists this group’s championship pedigree and postseason history don’t matter all that much at this stage.
